name: Winter Spiti Valley Expedition
description: An extraordinary winter journey into the remote and breathtaking landscapes of Spiti Valley. This adventure takes you through snow-covered mountains, ancient monasteries, and culturally rich villages untouched by time.
route: Delhi → Shimla → Sangla → Chitkul → Nako → Tabo → Dhankar → Kaza → Langza → Key → Chicham → Kalpa → Shimla → Delhi
highlights: Scenic drive through Narkanda and Kinnaur Valley
Visit to the peaceful Nako Village
Explore ancient monasteries like Tabo and Dhankar
Discover Key Monastery with its historic murals
Cross the iconic Chicham Bridge (one of Asia's highest)
Visit Langza Buddha Statue, Komic & Hikkim (world's highest post office)
Experience Giu Monastery with a preserved mummy

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.desc: Meet the group leader in Delhi and board Volvo bus for overnight journey to Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Sangla
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Shimla and proceed towards Sangla through scenic Kinnaur Valley. Overnight stay in Sangla.

itinerary.title: Sangla – Chitkul – Tabo
itinerary.desc: Visit Chitkul, the last inhabited village near Indo-Tibet border. Continue towards Nako Village. Arrive in Tabo for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tabo – Dhankar – Kaza
itinerary.desc: Explore Tabo Monastery. Visit Dhankar Monastery perched on a cliff. Proceed to Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza – Langza – Komic – Hikkim
itinerary.desc: Visit Langza Buddha Statue, Komic village (highest motorable village), and Hikkim post office. Return to Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza – Key Monastery – Chicham Bridge
itinerary.desc: Visit Key Monastery and drive to Chicham Bridge, one of Asia's highest bridges. Return to Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Kalpa
itinerary.desc: Travel to Kalpa, stopping at Giu Monastery. Enjoy stunning views of Kinnaur-Kailash range.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Shimla & Departure
itinerary.desc: Drive back to Shimla. Board Volvo bus to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Delhi early morning. End of trip.

inclusions: Experienced trip leader and local driver
